{{Quote|If he has slipped through our fingers, Andrid, it is due to your stupidity&hellip;and the egotism that led you to think that you could take Skywalker alone!|Darth Vader|<ref name="annual3" />}}
'''Andrid''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served as a [[General/Legends|General]] in the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], reporting directly to [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]]. Andrid was stationed in the [[Belderone sector/Legends|Belderone sector]] and was part of an effort to stop rising [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] support on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kulthis]]. In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], Andrid was summarily executed by Vader after trying and failing to [[Assassin/Legends|assassinate]] several key Rebel leaders without Vader's knowledge.

==Biography==
{{Quote|I see no reason to inform Lord Vader of this. I have other agents on Belderone. They can handle this...|Andrid|<ref name="annual3" />}}
A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]], Andrid served in the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]] and reached the rank of [[General/Legends|General]] by [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]]. An avowed skeptic of the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader's]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] background, Andrid served under Vader as the Empire moved in to tamp down growing [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] sentiment on [[Kulthis]]&mdash;Andrid had been tasked with overseeing production of [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|AT-AT]] [[Walker/Legends|walkers]] on nearby [[Belderone/Legends|Belderone]] to use in the coming assault on Kulthis. Warned by Vader that their work was crucial to the future of the war, Andrid decided to go behind the Sith Lord's back when an informant tipped him off that several key Rebel leaders, including [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]], had been spotted on Belderone, instead sending his own [[Assassin/Legends|assassins]] to deal with them. When that attempt failed, one of Vader's spies informed Vader of Andrid's subterfuge. Infuriated by Andrid's presumptuousness and ineffectiveness, Vader [[The Force/Legends|Force]] [[Telekinesis/Legends|choked]] the general to death where he sat.<ref name="annual3" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Lord Vader, I would be the last one to belittle your faith in that mystic energy field you refer to as the Force... or to imply that the training you received during your days as a ''Jedi Knight'' had made a romantic of you-!|Andrid|<ref name="annual3" />}}
Although a subordinate of Darth Vader, Andrid was bold enough to question Vader's faith in the Force and his Jedi background, even to Vader's face&mdash;he often though Vader exaggerated his own importance. Andrid's antipathy towards Vader veered towards actual insubordination in 3 ABY, when he attempted to kill the Rebels without the Sith Lord's knowledge. This directly led to Andrid's death, as Vader lashed out at what he saw as Andrid's stupidity and egotism.<ref name="annual3" />

==Behind the scenes==
Andrid appeared in [[Star Wars Annual (1977) 3|''Star Wars Annual'' (1977) 3]], written by [[Mary Jo Duffy]], illustrated by [[Klaus Janson]], and released in [[1983]].<ref name="annual3" />
